reasons: Saved video is lossy; original lossless network inputs and logits are unavailable.
No trusted dense robot/object/goal masks or occlusion ground truth were saved. Center-frustum labels do not protect object/goal pixels.
Robot wrist and task objects are adjacent in reviewed key frames. A small manually isolated distant arm patch would not isolate the full embodiment appearance mechanism.
Descriptive matched states do not control full history or true grasp feasibility.
Frozen BARX has not received Cloak-style masking training. Pixel ablation sensitivity would conflate lost task cues and out-of-distribution response; it cannot identify the cause sought here.
scope: No claim that every possible mask is impossible, that masking cannot help, or that visual appearance is irrelevant. Optional inference was not necessary to establish the saved-output/interface boundary and cannot presently identify the upstream mechanism.
